notes.title: Update April 27, 2024
notes.content:
Update April 27, 2024

Originally intended to focus on character customization in this update, and had to redo all character models for it. As a result, the update took much longer than expected, with little time left to spend on actual customization options. But, at least the framework for it is ready and in the future adding more options will take way less time.

The story mode introduced in the previous update had to be rolled back. Needs a lot more work before it’s ready. In it’s current state, I think, the game is better played in sandbox mode. Added new encounters and new quest chains for sandbox mode.

Added special rules for certain encounters (such as restrictions on available equipment, mercenaries, etc., requirements not to kill certain characters and more). Usually means your team is ambushed, or otherwise unable to fully prepare for an encounter. 

Added lots of new armor, including heavy armor.

Several QOL improvements.

Save files from previous version will not work.

notes.title: Update October 23, 2023
notes.content:
This update focuses on story and lore. Chapter 1 is now available. The story varies depending on your starting faction and has some amount of C&C. 
This is an early version.
Update not compatible with old saves.

-	Added dialogue interface.
-	New characters and mercenaries.
-	New portraits. 
-	Can now raise your characters’ stat levels using points you gain at level-ups.
-	Reworked mechanics of lethal/nonlethal attacks.
-	Rebalance of one-handed/two-handed weapons, precise attacks, status effects.
-	Some QOL improvements.

notes.title: Update May 22, 2023
notes.content:
Update May 22, 2023
	
-	Added magic system. In current version only damage and control spells. Magic requires power, skill (spellcraft), inspiration and control. Requirements are different for each spell. 

-	New classes, including magic users (Champion, Assassin, Duelist, Sniper, Sorcerer, Scholar, Battlemage, Ardent, Wild Soul). 

-	Rework of the character system. Fighting styles now give additional attacks with specific modifiers (powerful, fast, precise, feint etc.) that are effective in certain conditions. 

-	Feint mechanic. Certain classes has special attacks that use limited resource called Feint Points to make unpredictable attacks. 

-	Rework and rebalance of damage and penetration mechanics. Rebalance of classes and weapons.

-	Shields now add bonus defense points.

-	Interface improvements.

Save files from previous version is not compatible with current update!

notes.title: Feb 03 2023 update
notes.content:
- Reworking and rebalancing of defenses in combat. 
- Removed penalty to max AP from fatigue.  
- Added more abilities to interrupt and defend against enemy attacks (effect depends on character’s fatigue)
- UI and usability improvements.
- Bug fixes.

The battles are a bit longer now, with more emphasis on strategic planning and resource management. 

Using saves from previous version may cause problems.
